# メルカリShops宛名ラベル作成ツール (Mercari Shops Mailing Label Tool)

> A free web tool that creates mailing labels in Nagagata No.3 envelope format from Mercari Shops order CSV files. Everything runs in the browser; order data and personal information are never uploaded to a server.

## Tool

- [メルカリShops宛名ラベル作成ツール](https://mercari-print.miupa.jp/): Upload a Mercari Shops order CSV, set the sender information, and print address labels sized for Nagagata No.3 envelopes. Sender information can be saved in the browser for reuse. No sign-up, no data collection.

## About

- [MiUPa portfolio](https://miupa.jp/): Other free tools and Chrome extensions by the same developer.
- [GitHub](https://github.com/MiUPa/mercari-print)
